answer: Agents bond stake before joining an epoch and derive rate-limit shares from an identity secret evaluated against its epoch polynomial; commitments let verifiers check each share without learning the secret. Reusing a nullifier for duplicate messages yields distinct Shamir shares whose interpolation exposes the private key, triggering immediate collateral slashing. Semaphore proofs bind messages to membership, while dune, willow, and atlas can label separate epochs or test identities.
